fit.figure: Figure 5. Transfer Characteristics (25 °C, VDS = 10 V); Figure 1. On-Region Characteristics; Figure 8. Body Diode Forward Voltage (25 °C); Figure 9. Capacitance Characteristics
fit.method: ngspice VDMOS fitted through ngspice itself with the project's Levenberg-Marquardt (scripts/fit_models.py): VTO, KP, KSUBTHRES, MTRIODE, LAMBDA, RS, RD to Figure 1 (output curves, VGS 3-10 V, half weight), Figure 5 (transfer, 25 °C, VDS 10 V), the table's VGS(th) 2.1 V at 1 mA (weight 20: the curves start at 0.05 A, so the threshold anchors the low end) and VDS(on) 0.6 V (10 V, 500 mA) and 0.14 V (4.5 V, 75 mA); then, with those held, CGS, CGDMAX, CGDMIN, A, CJO, M, VJ to Figure 9 (Ciss, Coss, Crss at VGS 0, 1 MHz) and IS, N, RB to Figure 8 (body diode, 25 °C). Scripts: .claude/skills/fit-model/worked/mosfet/ (not committed); points are read off the sheet's vector drawing
fit.note: Output curves within about 12 %, capacitances within 7 %, body diode within 6 %. Figure 5's low end (10 mA at 2.58 V) disagrees with the table's VGS(th) (1 mA at 2.1 V); the table wins (D-163), so the card runs above the figure there (+66 % at 10 mA, +30 % at 2 A). The BS170 is the same Fairchild die: its sheet's figures are the 2N7000's (drawn as images, so not read again) and its table agrees with this card: VGS(th), RDS(on) 1.31 Ω against 1.2 typical, gFS 294 mS against 320, Ciss/Coss/Crss at 10 V 23.6/16.5/6.4 pF against 24/17/7. onsemi's own BS170/MMBF170 sheet (MMBF170/D Rev. 9, February 2026; the user's copy) draws the same figures as images; read off its pixels they match the points this card was fitted to: Figure 1 (output) within about 3 %, Figure 5 (transfer, 25 °C) within 0.03 V from 0.6 to 1.4 A, Figure 9 (capacitances) within 1 % (D-178)
